title: Epic listing
description: The epic ids a record holds, in id order, as `wipctl epic --json` emits them with no id named. It is a listing and not a rollup: it carries no points and no completion, because a bare invocation is a caller asking which epics exist rather than how they are going. The rollup is epics.schema.json and the single-epic resolution is epic.schema.json.

id.description: The title's slug, plus at most a qualifying postfix where that slug was taken. Shared across stories, epics, initiatives, and questions, so one id names one thing.
